Some employees of the Teza tea factory were killed and others injured. Two soldiers were injured and many assailants killed. Eight Kalashnikov rifles belonging to the assailants were recovered by security forces. The assailants later withdrew towards Musigati.   Also, according to military sources, an ambush occurred today on National Road No 1 on a bus transporting civilians. The bus was heading to the interior of the country.
